card.name: Idioms and partway through rare names
card.fires_on: The word of or for inside fixed idioms like "got the best of him" and "bang for buck". Also fires partway through rare foreign place names and surnames.

modes.label: Idiom links
modes.description: Small linking words in set phrases, just before the phrase finishes.
modes.example: his temper got the best<< of>> him.

modes.label: Rare names split up
modes.description: Middle pieces of unusual foreign names or terms broken into parts.
modes.example: Pusz<<ta>> is exploited by sheep and cattle raising.
